description: Golden vectors for the watering planner. Every implementation must reproduce these exactly. Dates are local calendar dates built from their components, so the vectors stay timezone independent.

vectors.name: indoor medium plant in a neutral month uses the species baseline

expected.title: Check soil in 10 days
expected.reason: Based on its starting interval and the fact that it is kept indoors. Feel the soil before watering.

vectors.name: outdoor container in direct summer sun dries fastest

expected.title: Check soil in 4 days
expected.reason: Based on its starting interval and the fact that it is an outdoor pot can dry faster, direct sun can dry soil faster, it is the warmer part of the year. Feel the soil before watering.

vectors.name: low light indoor plant stretches in winter

expected.title: Check soil in 14 days
expected.reason: Based on its starting interval and the fact that it is kept indoors, lower light usually slows water use, plants often use less water in cooler months. Feel the soil before watering.

vectors.name: a due date in the past reports overdue

expected.title: Check soil now
expected.reason: Based on its starting interval and the fact that it is kept indoors. Feel the soil before watering.

vectors.name: a due date landing on today reports due today

expected.title: Check soil today
expected.reason: Based on its starting interval and the fact that it is kept indoors. Feel the soil before watering.

vectors.name: one day out uses the singular day phrase

expected.title: Check soil in 1 day
expected.reason: Based on its starting interval and the fact that it is kept indoors. Feel the soil before watering.
